mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AS article_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AS favorite_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AS comment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_like ul INNER JOIN article a ON a.id = ul.article_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId}) AS like_received_count
